# Immutable-base root benchmarks

This directory preserves the exact root benchmark sources from eventloop commit `986e2378c1484aa917a1bb0fd13aef914bdce50f`.

These files are an independent historical catalog authority. Each benchmark root must have a manifest binding classified as an active port, an explicitly equivalent merged root, or a revision-only executable. Files here are source evidence and are not compiled as part of the current eventloop package.
